title: Gail Kim vs. Taryn Terrell
summary: A conflict between veteran Gail Kim and referee-turned-wrestler Taryn Terrell becomes a showcase for the Knockouts. Their rivalry escalates from Last Knockout Standing to a ladder match.

chapters.title: Terrell wins Last Knockout Standing
chapters.context: Terrell survives the veteran’s punishment and wins a dangerous brawl, proving she can compete beyond her former officiating role.

chapters.title: Gail answers in the ladder rematch
chapters.result: Gail Kim defeats Terrell to become number-one contender.
chapters.context: Kim ties Terrell’s hair to the ropes to create the opening to climb. The rematch gives Gail a title opportunity and a measure of revenge.
